text: Iron Veil's 64/34 mirror-match split is the initiative tie-break (TurnQueue sorts ties by unit id, so 'e' acts before 'p'), not bulkhead terrain: handing ties to A flips it to 33/64. See lab/findings/side-skew.md (2026-10-03).
